metadata.collection_method: Authorized assistant UI reading; not user in-person observation or a field survey
metadata.sampling: 140 unique message items from bounded loaded Discord samples in 8 of eight challenge channels. Repeated sightings are deduplicated by message ID. Samples have different displayed time spans and do not establish full-channel or common-interval coverage.
metadata.provenance: Message IDs, visible dates/times, display-label aliases and paraphrases supplied by the main assistant after reading the Discord interface. Original usernames and verbatim message text are omitted.
metadata.identity_note: Aliases identify rendered display labels within a channel. Prefixes prevent accidental cross-channel matches; they are not verified people or teams and must not be summed as unique participants.
metadata.eligibility_note: The written Build-A-Dataset guide requires primary physical-world collection. The user reports an organizer exception allowing remote observations; its exact scope has not been independently verified.
limits: 0 challenge channels have no inspected message content; missing activity remains null, not zero
No messages-per-hour calculation: sampled time spans are not complete observation intervals
No cross-challenge popularity or competition ranking; loaded sample sizes reflect acquisition coverage
No total participant, team, entrant or valid-submission counts; participant claims are not verified counts
No inferred mental health, numerical difficulty, prize motivation or personal winning probability
Categories are single-assistant content interpretations, not independently human-validated responses
metadata.reaction_note: Latest reaction readings cover 2 of 140 message items. Counts across emoji are reaction events, not unique reactors. Missing readings stay null; no growth or velocity is estimated.
metadata.navigation_attempt_note: Earlier navigation attempts were blocked. Newly acquired channel samples are recorded individually; channels without message evidence remain unread.
